Show that each such minorant vanishes off the box, has values at most e^{βBN} on it, and therefore has simple integral at most e^{βBN}λ_d^{⊗N}(Λ_L^N); then take the supremum.

Steps 2.1 and 3.1 infer equality of integrals under coordinate permutations and common translations from product-measure invariance, but do not establish that these measure-preserving maps preserve nonnegative integrals.
